Under Florida law, here are the conditions eligible for a Medical Marijuana Card:
Post-traumatic stress disorder is an anxiety disorder that may develop in people who have experienced or witnessed a traumatic event.
Epilepsy is a neurological condition that causes recurring, unprovoked seizures. A seizure is a sudden rush of abnormal electrical activity in your brain.
A progressive brain disorder that causes unintended or uncontrollable movements, such as shaking, stiffness, and difficulty with balance and coordination.
An immune-mediated inflammatory disease that affects the central nervous system which disrupts the flow of information in the brain and between the brain and body.
A chronic inflammatory bowel disease that affects the lining of the digestive tract.
Eye conditions marked by increased intraocular pressure that can cause blindness.
Sudden, involuntary movement in one or more muscles.
Human immunodeficiency virus that, over time, causes acquired immunodeficiency syndrome.
A nervous system disease that weakens muscles and affects physical function.
Disease caused by an uncontrolled division of abnormal cells in a given part of the body.
Pain unrelated to cancer that persists beyond the usual course of disease or injury.
What You Get Using Tampa Bay Family Clinic
Your recommendation is only valid for 210 days in Florida, and you will need to recertify your license and incur the fee for another appointment once it expires.
To Qualify for the Medical Marijuana Program in Florida, You Must:

Becoming a medical marijuana patient in Florida is a 3-step process. First, a licensed medical marijuana doctor will review your ailments and medical condition. Once you are assessed and if you are approved, you will receive a medical marijuana recommendation from the doctor.
Finally, once you are approved for medical marijuana, you can purchase medical marijuana from any Florida dispensary in your area.
You MUST accomplish the application for a Medical Marijuana Use Registry Identification Card with the Department of Health Office of Medical Marijuana Use in Florida.
The Medical Marijuana Card issued in Florida is VALID FOR 210 DAYS ONLY. You must renew your card within that time frame.
To qualify for the medical marijuana program in Florida you must:
Have proof of qualifying medical condition/s through medical records
Be recommended by a doctor for marijuana use (the doctor must be registered with the Florida MMJ program)
Minors must have recommendations from 2 physicians and consent from their legal guardian
The state will send you your physical medical marijuana card once your application is approved

Do you need to be a resident to become a medical marijuana patient in Florida?

Yes. You need to have either a valid Florida driver's license or a current state identification card as proof of your residency. There are also special requirements for seasonal residents to obtain their cards.
How long does it take to get a medical marijuana card in Florida, including the initial consultation?

From beginning to end, the consultation usually takes about 10-15 minutes. The whole process, from having an appointment to registering with the state and accessing dispensaries, can be expected to take at least 2 to 3 weeks.
What if I'm not approved after my initial consultation with a Florida MMJ doctor?
Tampa Bay Family Clinic has a very high approval rate. However, if you are not approved, you will receive a full refund.
What types of MMJ products can I purchase in Florida dispensaries?

MMJ patients are able to purchase all kinds of medical marijuana products at their local dispensary. MMJ products include everything from dry cannabis flower, pre-rolls, and vapes, to tinctures and topicals.
How much does a Florida medical marijuana card cost?

A patient is responsible for the cost of each visit to their medical marijuana doctor. In addition, each patient (and designated caregiver) must possess a Registry ID Card to access dispensary products. The Registry ID Card costs $75, paid annually to the Florida state Office of Medical Marijuana Use.
